BiblicalUsage: Chisleu is the ninth Hebrew month. Nehemiah 1:1 dates Nehemiah's grief for Jerusalem to the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as he stood in Shushan the palace, and Zechariah 7:1 dates the word of the LORD to Zechariah to the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the month matters because God dates His work: Nehemiah's prayer and Zechariah's word both arrived in Chisleu, and the calendar of His people is a record of when He spoke.
